children: Tunisia has moving ahead with plans to develop a 200-megawatt (MW) photovoltaic power plant in the Borj Bourguiba area of Tataouine Governorate in the south, according to local Arabic news portal Mosaique FM.

The news portal said two potential sites in Borj Bourguiba have been identified for the proposed solar plant, adding that state utility Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas (STEG) will be the offtaker for the electricity.
Tunisia has set a target of 35 percent share for renewable energy in electricity generation by 2030.
(Writing by Majda Muhsen; Editing by Anoop Menon)
